name: Process Engine Settings
description: Engine-wide defaults. Anything set here can be overridden per process or per step.

fields.label: Alternate Language Label
fields.description: What the language toggle in the app is called. Content itself lives in the *_alt fields on stages and steps.

fields.label: Offline Retention (days)
fields.description: How long the app keeps a synced run on the device before clearing it.

fields.label: Geofence
fields.description: Advisory only. Geofence status is recorded on each photo and shown on the report; it never blocks a capture, because indoor GPS is unreliable and a blocked operator finds a second phone.

fields.label: Entry Advisories
fields.description: Flags surfaced on the report so implausible data entry is visible. Never blocking — the aim is that the truth is easy to record and dishonesty is easy to see, not that the operator is policed at the point of work.

fields.label: Fast Entry Threshold (%)
fields.description: A step answered in less than this share of its expected_seconds is flagged Fast Entry.

fields.label: Late Entry Threshold (min)
fields.description: A photo received this long after its capture time is flagged Late Entry.

fields.label: Current App Capability
fields.description: The step-type capability level the latest released app supports. Publishing a process above this warns the author that older installs will render some steps read-only.
